conditions.text: Get written confirmation of permitted use for the UCI air-quality dataset. Its page says CC BY 4.0 but also says 'used exclusively for research purposes; commercial purposes are fully excluded'. Use it for the prototype only, never for the production warning model, until this is resolved.
conditions.owner: Makrand Bhandari with the project Legal contact

conditions.text: Recode the documented -200 sentinel (including the float form -200.0 in C6H6(GT)) to missing in every numeric column before any aggregation or model fit.
Obtain and record a licence for the Eurostat sdg_11_52 indicator (LIC-UNKNOWN) before any use. It is national annual context only (need N6).
Obtain access to the Environment Monitoring Unit station data and the Mobility Office traffic counts (ACC-RESTRICTED) before the production window can be met.
conditions.owner: Valdena Civic Health Office data owner

agreements.reason: Agree it is the only usable public hourly NO2 source for prototype N1 and it covers the prototype window exactly (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04). The -200 sentinel is documented, so it can be recoded. Agree it is a method-building source for one road-level site, not a city-wide source.

Agree with not_feasible. The host catalog.data.gov is refused by the allowlist (intended), no licence was read, and the data is for a US city outside the IT geography. The refusal is the finding; no alternate route is used.

traced_conclusion.could_change_if: If the licence owner or UCI confirms commercial use is excluded, the prototype N1 use stops (the source becomes not_feasible for N1); if the -200 recode leaves too few complete hours in the prototype window, coverage falls below the 0.95 partial-window threshold.
